title: Bug: tmux сессии Claude неожиданно прерываются
description:
Сессии tmux с Claude Code неожиданно прерываются/падают.

ДОБАВЛЕНО ЛОГИРОВАНИЕ:
- Включено CCC_TMUX_VERBOSE=1 в systemd сервисе
- tmux теперь пишет логи в tmux-server-PID.log и tmux-client-PID.log
- Логи будут в директории где запущен ccc

ОЖИДАЕМ:
При следующем падении сессии проверить логи tmux для понимания причины.

ИСТОРИЯ:
- /exit в транскрипте - ложный след, Claude завершился, но tmux сессия тоже упала
- Память и диск в норме
- Нет OOM kills
close_reason: Root cause: systemd default KillMode=control-group kills tmux server when ccc service restarts. Fix: Added KillMode=process to ~/.config/systemd/user/ccc.service.d/verbose.conf. Now only the main ccc process will be killed on restart, leaving tmux sessions intact.

title: AskUserQuestion forwarding to Telegram (inline keyboard)
description:
Port PreToolUse hook handling of AskUserQuestion from upstream.

## New subcommand:
- `ccc hook-permission` — called by Claude Code PreToolUse hook

## hook-permission flow for AskUserQuestion:
1. Read stdin JSON (hookData with toolName, toolInput, cwd)
2. If toolName == 'AskUserQuestion' and questions present:
   - For each question: send ❓ message with inline keyboard buttons
   - Button callback data: `{sessionName}:{qIdx}:{totalQuestions}:{optionIdx}`
   - Return immediately (don't block Claude)

## Telegram callback handling:
Add to Telegram update loop:
1. Parse CallbackQuery from updates
2. Parse callback data string
3. Edit original message (append ✓ Selected, remove keyboard)
4. Send to tmux: Down arrow × optionIndex, then Enter
5. If last question: extra Enter after 300ms to auto-submit

## New Telegram types needed:
- CallbackQuery struct
- InlineKeyboardButton / InlineKeyboardMarkup
- sendMessageWithKeyboard()
- answerCallbackQuery()
- editMessageRemoveKeyboard()

## Also store in history:
- Question as {from:'claude', text:'❓ ...'} 
- Answer as {from:'human', text:'Selected: option label'}

Ref: upstream hooks.go:262-313, commands.go:750-798
close_reason: Deployed to all 4 machines. PreToolUse hook + inline keyboard + callback handler with remote support + auto-submit.

title: Hooks infrastructure: Stop hook + extractLastTurn + installHook
description:
Port from upstream and adapt to our codebase.

## New subcommands:
- `ccc hook-stop` — called by Claude Code Stop hook
- `ccc install-hook` / `ccc uninstall-hook` — manage ~/.claude/settings.json

## hook-stop flow:
1. Read stdin JSON (hookData with transcriptPath, cwd, sessionId)
2. Match session via findSession(cwd)
3. Call extractLastTurn(transcriptPath) to parse JSONL transcript
4. Send text blocks to Telegram with ✅ prefix (like upstream)
5. Store in history via appendHistory()

## extractLastTurn(transcriptPath):
Port from upstream hooks.go:99-241. Key logic:
- Parse JSONL file, handle both nested (message.content) and flat formats
- Find last real user message (skip tool_results)
- Collect assistant text blocks after it
- Streaming dedup by requestId (last entry wins)
- Return []string of text blocks

## installHook:
Port from upstream hooks.go:458-537. Writes to ~/.claude/settings.json:
- Stop hook: `ccc hook-stop`
- PreToolUse hook: `ccc hook-permission` (for subtask 2)

## Remove after validation:
- captureResponseAsync()
- captureClaudeResponse()
- isClaudeUIArtifact()
- getLastClaudeResponse()
- All debug logging in capture functions

## Keep:
- captureTmuxPane() for screenshot API
- checkClaudeState() for busy/idle
- appendHistoryDedup() (still needed for dedup)

Ref: upstream hooks.go:50-260

title: External Agent API: REST API для взаимодействия внешних агентов с CCC
Проектирование API схемы и выбор механизма доставки ответов
description:
## Решения по дизайну API

### Транспорт
- **Unix Socket** (`~/.ccc.sock`) — локальное взаимодействие на том же хосте
- **JSON протокол** — newline-delimited JSON (одна строка = одно сообщение)
- НЕ HTTP — избыточно для локального IPC

### Сценарии использования
1. **Запрос-ответ** — оркестратор спрашивает конкретную сессию, получает ответ
2. **Фоновый мониторинг** — оркестратор подписывается на события, обновляет свой контекст

### API команды

| Команда | Описание | Соединение |
|---------|----------|------------|
| `sessions` | Список всех сессий | короткое |
| `ask` | Блокирующий запрос-ответ | короткое (до 5 мин) |
| `send` | Отправить без ожидания | короткое |
| `history` | Получить историю сообщений | короткое |
| `subscribe` | Поток событий | persistent |

### Интеграция с Telegram
- Все сообщения через API дублируются в Telegram топик
- Формат: `🤖 [agent-name] текст сообщения`
- Человек видит взаимодействие и может участвовать

### Формат сообщений
См. полную спецификацию в описании epic ccc-dcp
close_reason: Design decisions documented in epic description

title: Implement message history storage (JSONL files)
description:
Store all messages in JSONL files for history retrieval.

## Structure
```
~/.ccc/history/<topic_id>/messages/<YYYY-MM-DD-HH>.jsonl
```

## Message format
```jsonl
{"id":123,"ts":1705412345,"from":"human|claude|api","text":"..."}
{"id":124,"ts":1705412400,"from":"human","type":"voice","path":"...","transcription":"..."}
{"id":125,"ts":1705412500,"from":"api","agent":"orchestrator","text":"..."}
```

## Implementation
- Append message on every incoming/outgoing message
- Create new file each hour
- Store artifact paths (not copies)
- No rotation (keep forever)

This is a prerequisite for the `history` command.

title: Bug: Сообщения попадают в bash при падении Claude Code
description:
## Проблема
Когда Claude Code падает/крашится, tmux сессия остаётся активной. Сообщения из Telegram продолжают отправляться в tmux через send-keys, но попадают в bash shell вместо Claude Code.

## Текущее поведение
1. Claude Code падает в tmux сессии
2. tmux сессия остаётся (bash prompt)
3. Пользователь отправляет сообщение в Telegram
4. CCC отправляет его в tmux через send-keys
5. Сообщение выполняется как bash команда (!)

## Ожидаемое поведение
CCC должен проверять состояние Claude Code до/после отправки сообщения и информировать пользователя если Claude Code не работает.

## Возможные решения
1. Проверять процесс claude в tmux перед отправкой
2. Использовать tmux hooks для отслеживания завершения процесса
3. Автоматически предлагать перезапуск

## Связанные задачи
- Зависит от ccc-006 (Add /status command)

## Риски
- Сообщения могут выполниться как shell команды (безопасность)

title: MCP agent directory: list_agents / get_agent / update_self (self-owned cards)
description: Self-service agent registry exposed over MCP. Three layers of truth merged on read: (1) mechanical (CCC-owned: name, status, working dir, host, topic — from config.Sessions + checkClaudeState; socket 'sessions' already returns most); (2) self-declared card (agent-owned: description, areas[], contact_about — written by the agent); (3) policy (secretary instruction — out of scope here). MCP methods: list_agents() [all agents, cheap/last-known status] and get_agent(name) [live status] — readable by every agent; update_self({description,areas,contact_about}) — caller edits ONLY its own card, identity derived from cwd/session like trusted 'from' (cannot edit others). Storage: one file per agent ~/.ccc/registry/<agent>.json (no cross-agent write contention). Defaults: card = description/areas/contact_about (no who-may-write — that's policy); update_self = full replace; list = cheap status, get = live status. Feeds both the secretary's routing and any sender's recipient discovery.

title: Add Telegram notification on context compaction (PreCompact hook)
Letter delivery-state tracking: tmux_delivered / agent_acked / replied + per-stage timeouts + MCP ack
description: Track each outbound letter through a 3-stage state machine, each with its own deadline (configurable defaults): tmux_delivered (send-keys success, <=60s) -> agent_acked (recipient calls MCP ack(ticket), 5-10min) -> replied (recipient calls MCP send(in_reply_to=ticket), up to 60min; only if reply_to set). CCC owns mechanical truth + timers: stamps tmux_delivered, receives ack/reply via MCP, arms per-stage deadlines via the scheduler (ccc-84e). On a missed deadline CCC appends a 'timeout' journal event and WAKES the secretary with the fact -- CCC does NOT decide the response. Escalation (resend/notify Vlad/reroute) lives in the secretary's INSTRUCTION, not Go. Storage: append-only journal events keyed by ticket (received/delivered/acked/replied/timeout); no in-place edits -> no races between CCC and secretary. New MCP tool: ack(ticket). Confirmation model = combination (tmux send-keys + explicit agent MCP ack); hooks NOT used as primary signal.

title: Implement hooks + transcript JSONL for response capture (merged from ccc-zsf)
description:
Replace capture-pane + isClaudeUIArtifact approach with hooks + transcript JSONL (merged from ccc-zsf research).

## Architecture (from upstream analysis)

### Two hooks to install:
1. **Stop hook** (hook-stop): fires when Claude finishes a turn. Receives stdin JSON with transcriptPath. Calls extractLastTurn() to parse JSONL transcript and extract text blocks from last assistant turn. Sends to Telegram with ✅ prefix. This replaces captureResponseAsync polling.

2. **PreToolUse hook** (hook-permission): fires before each tool call. Handles two cases:
   - AskUserQuestion: sends inline keyboard buttons to Telegram, user presses button, listener sends arrow keys + Enter to tmux to select option
   - Other tools (with OTP enabled): sends permission request to Telegram, waits for TOTP code

### Key function: extractLastTurn(transcriptPath)
- Reads JSONL file (~/.claude/projects/*/sessions/*.jsonl)
- Finds last real user message (skipping tool_results)
- Collects assistant text blocks after it
- Handles streaming dedup by requestId (last entry with text wins)
- Returns []string of text blocks

### Migration plan:
1. Add hook-stop and hook-permission subcommands to ccc binary
2. Port extractLastTurn() from upstream hooks.go
3. Port handlePermissionHook() for AskUserQuestion forwarding
4. Add installHook/uninstallHook commands
5. Add CallbackQuery handling in Telegram listener (arrow keys to tmux)
6. Keep captureResponseAsync as fallback for sessions without hooks installed
7. Remove capture-pane based getLastClaudeResponse once hooks are stable

### Benefits:
- Eliminates ALL isClaudeUIArtifact filter issues
- Eliminates echo detection problems
- Eliminates response truncation (ccc-e7s)
- Enables AskUserQuestion forwarding (new capability)
- Enables OTP permissions (ccc-xxo depends on this)

Ref: upstream hooks.go, commands.go (callback handling)
close_reason: Replaced by new epic with subtasks for hooks + transcript + interactive Q&A

title: AskUserQuestion via CCC API (for programmatic agents)
description:
NEW capability not in upstream. Allow programmatic agents (like OpenClaw/Loki) to see Claude's questions and answer them via CCC API.

## Design:

### Storing questions:
When hook-permission receives AskUserQuestion:
- Store question in a per-session pending queue (file or in-memory)
- Include: sessionName, questions[], timestamp, status (pending/answered)
- Path: ~/.ccc/questions/{sessionName}.json

### New API commands:

1. `{"cmd":"questions","session":"name"}` — list pending questions
   Response: {ok:true, questions:[{question, header, options[], timestamp}]}

2. `{"cmd":"answer","session":"name","question_index":0,"option_index":1}` — answer a question
   - Sends arrow keys to tmux (same as Telegram callback)
   - Marks question as answered
   - Auto-submits if last question
   Response: {ok:true}

### History integration:
- Questions appear in history as from:'claude' with special marker
- Answers appear as from:'human'
- Agents can poll history to detect new questions

### Concurrency:
- Telegram and API can both answer — first one wins
- After answer via either path, question removed from pending queue
- tmux send-keys is idempotent (worst case: extra Down/Enter which is harmless with proper guards)

### Timeout:
- Questions expire after 5 minutes (Claude Code's own timeout)
- Expired questions auto-cleaned on next poll
close_reason: questions/answer API endpoints implemented, tested, deployed to all machines
